expected_dmg.formula: 240 + 30*(Postwick? + ExtraHelpings_in_play? + ChoiceBand_on_attacker?), max 330; x2 if defender weak to Metal; costs {M}{M}{M} with Band (needs 3 real Metal), else {M}{M}{M}{C}; self-locks next turn
active = 30 + 30*(buffs), max 120; benched target = 30 flat (no buff, no weakness); cost {C} (0 with Band)
active = 140 + 30*(buffs, incl own Extra Helpings), max 230; 80 damage to self
100 flat to ANY 1 opponent Pokemon, ignores Weakness/Resistance; Fezandipiti is NOT a Hop's Pokemon so NO buff applies; display shows 0
120 + 30*(buffs) if opponent has exactly 3 or 4 prizes remaining, else 0; cost {C}
30 + (100 if any of your Hop's Pokemon were KO'd by an attack during opponent's last turn) + 30*(buffs); up to ~220; cost {C}
90 + buffs, but requires {P} which the deck cannot supply -> NEVER usable (type-dead)

early.until: a Zacian is Active with >=1 Metal and Postwick is in play
early.on_plan: Snorlax benched, Postwick played, Band on Zacian, Insta-Strike each turn (active 120 + bench 30 snipe); dig with Pokegear/Hop's Bag/Poke Pad

mid.until: active Zacian holds >=3 Basic Metal AND a Choice Band
mid.on_plan: Brave Slash 330 on fresh turns; on the self-lock turn Insta-Strike or Switch to a 2nd loaded Zacian; Boss's Orders the KO target; first_attack_turn(413) <= 4

late.on_plan: close with Brave Slash + Boss's on last-prize target; in prize-3/4 window Cramorant Fickle Spitting = 150 for 1 energy; Cruel Arrow snipes a lethal benched threat; stop Ultra/Secret to avoid deckout

doctrines.name: A: single-Zacian + Insta rotation
doctrines.plan: One Zacian is the Brave-Slash core; on its self-lock turn it Insta-Strikes (120 active + 30 snipe) instead of idling. Cheap on energy and Bands.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share concentrated on one Zacian serial; high play_rate[412] on turns immediately after a Brave Slash (413)

doctrines.name: B: two-Zacian tag-team
doctrines.plan: Load two Zacians (each with a Choice Band + 3 Metal) and Brave Slash every turn by alternating fresh bodies via Switch. Sustained 330 OHKOs but slow to assemble (6 Metal, 2 Bands, 1 attach/turn).
doctrines.discriminating_metric: energy_attach_share split across >=2 Zacian serials; retreat_count/Switch play_rate high; continuous post-Brave OHKOs (post_ko_attack_rate high) with later first_attack_turn

tensions.balance: energy is 1/turn with no accel: attach ALL Metal to the first Zacian until it has 3 {M}; only then fork energy to a 2nd attacker or Snorlax
fire hand-shuffle/discard cards (Judge, Lillie's, Ultra, Secret) only when hand lacks a playable win-piece AND hand-size is low/clogged AND deckCount is not low
buff only to the minimum that OHKOs the current target (240/270/300 already kill most); do not spend a turn assembling the 4th 30 when a KO is already available

hypotheses.claim: The engine fires a hand-shuffle Supporter (Judge or Lillie's Determination) at hand<=5 while the hand holds an about-to-be-played win-turn (Zacian + Choice Band + Postwick / the only Zacian), shuffling the win condition back into the deck and wasting the turn.
hypotheses.direction: Judge/Lillie's play_rate on turns where hand contains an unplayed Zacian+Band+Postwick combo (or the last Zacian) must be ~0; these Supporters must correlate with LOWER not higher loss
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: if gated too hard the deck stops refueling clogged/dead hands and bricks; Lillie's is the main draw engine
hypotheses.scenario: Give player0 a hand of {Zacian ex, Hop's Choice Band, Postwick, Judge, 2 filler}; Zacian is Active with 2 Metal (one more attach = Brave Slash next turn). Hand size 6 -> if the engine fires Judge/Lillie's (hand>=5 or 'dig') it shuffles Zacian+Band+Postwick away, redraws 4/6, and loses the assembled OHKO turn. Regression: assert the combo pieces stay in hand / get played, not shuffled.
hypotheses.pattern: self-harm effect gated by board/hand state

hypotheses.claim: The energy loader counts Mist Energy (or too-few Metal) toward Zacian's load and treats it as ready, but Brave Slash needs 3 REAL Metal (Mist provides {C} only and never satisfies {M}); Brave Slash then never fires despite 3 energy attached.
hypotheses.direction: play_rate[413] must rise once a Zacian holds >=3 Basic Metal; Mist Energy must NOT be attached to the intended Brave-Slash Zacian as one of its 3

threshold.value: Brave Slash fires within 1 turn of the Zacian reaching 3 Metal in >=0.8 of games

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forbidding Mist on Zacian entirely loses the effect-immunity tech and the no-Band {C} filler
hypotheses.pattern: type-aware load check (count Metal, not energy count)

hypotheses.claim: Fezandipiti's Cruel Arrow (display 0, real 100 to ANY target, ignores Weakness/Resistance) is never used and the engine never feeds/gusts around it, so the deck loses a bench-snipe finisher; more broadly display-0/low-face attacks are undervalued.
hypotheses.direction: with Fezandipiti in play + 3 colorless-payable energy AND a lethal or high-value 100-snipe available, Cruel Arrow play_rate must be > 0
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: over-feeding Fezandipiti's 3 energy steals Metal from Zacian (T1) and exposes a 2-prize body
hypotheses.pattern: promote real-damage formula to shared perception

hypotheses.claim: Cramorant is sent to attack (Fickle Spitting, display 120) when the opponent does NOT have exactly 3 or 4 prizes, so the attack does nothing and the turn is wasted.
hypotheses.direction: Fickle Spitting must only be used when opponent prize_count in {3,4}; whiff-rate ~0
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: too strict a gate could skip a 150-for-1-energy KO exactly inside the window; keep the window at {3,4}

hypotheses.claim: Brave Slash's self-lock ('can't use Brave Slash next turn') is not modelled, so on the off-turn the engine idles or under-attacks instead of Insta-Striking (120) or Switching to a second loaded Zacian.
hypotheses.direction: the turn after a Brave Slash must still deal damage (Insta-Strike, or Brave Slash from a different Zacian serial); nonattacking_turn_rate on those turns must be near 0
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: forcing an attack every off-turn could burn Insta-Strike into a body that would rather retreat/reload; allow Switch as the 'attack' substitute

hypotheses.claim: The engine sends Snorlax (display 140 Dynamic Press) into the Active spot to attack, taking 80 self-damage and exposing the Extra-Helpings anchor to an easy KO, when Snorlax should stay benched as a passive buff.
hypotheses.direction: Snorlax attack rate (Dynamic Press) must be near 0 except as a scored desperation (no Zacian available)
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: banning it outright removes a legit 200+ emergency swing when no Zacian is available
hypotheses.pattern: self-harm effect gated by board state

hypotheses.claim: The loader ignores Choice Band's cost reduction and keeps attaching a 4th Metal to a Zacian that already has 3 + Band, wasting energy that a 2nd attacker needs.
hypotheses.direction: once the intended Zacian has 3 Metal + Band, extra Metal should go to a second attacker rather than a 4th on the same body

threshold.value: avg Metal on the Brave-Slash Zacian <= 3.3

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: a hard cap of 3 loses a buffer Metal against energy-removal decks

hypotheses.claim: Buff pieces are not prioritized before the first big attack (Postwick not played, no Snorlax benched, Band not attached), so Brave Slash lands for 240-300 and under-KOs high-HP targets, or Insta-Strike stays at 30-90.
hypotheses.direction: at the first Brave Slash, Postwick in play and a Band on the attacker should be present in the large majority of games; a Snorlax should be benched early
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: insisting on all 3 buffs before attacking (T3 tension) idles turns when 240 already OHKOs a low-HP target

hypotheses.claim: The engine treats Trevenant as an attacker toward its 90-face Corner and funnels energy to it, but Corner requires {P} which the deck cannot supply (type-dead), stranding energy.
hypotheses.direction: energy on Trevenant should be ~0 beyond the single {C} for Horrifying Revenge; Corner play_rate must be 0

hypotheses.claim: Unconditional every-turn use of Ultra Ball / Secret Box (and reshuffling Judge/Lillie's) thins the deck and, in long games, causes a deckout loss.
hypotheses.direction: deckout loss_share must stay low; ball/search usage should taper when deckCount is low
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: stopping search too early bricks the mid-game dig for buff pieces
hypotheses.pattern: stop-digging gate when deck is thin
